normalization_plan.reason: _from is a temporary parameter fully consumed by transferFrom and carries no independent state
_to is a temporary parameter only used as the recipient inside transferFrom
_value is a temporary amount parameter scoped to transferFrom
_tos is the transient recipient array argument of batchSend
i is a transient loop index with no meaning outside batchSend
spender is the transient target address argument of _mints
addedValue is the transient minted amount argument of _mints
_from is only used for whitelist comparison inside ensure
_value is only used for min/max sale comparison inside condition
